archetypes.name: dyn-runlog-refresh
archetypes.rationale: Changed PR creation and CI-fix push ordering for run-log refresh semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed ship and CI-fix code paths that commit run-log batches before an existing push. Focus on whether warning-triggered refresh failures block only the intended push paths and whether rebase force-push behavior remains unchanged. Check that duplicate guideline invalidation remains harmless and that the PR body still receives the original note text. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
